stdout:
usage: fleet-switchboard gates [-h] [--plan PLAN] [--ask ASK] [--head HEAD]
                               [--json] [--limit LIMIT] [--all]
                               pr [rest ...]

positional arguments:
  pr             The pull request: owner/repo#N or its URL
  rest           With `mode`: <owner/repo> <shadow|enforce|off>

options:
  -h, --help     show this help message and exit
  --plan PLAN    The plan: owner/repo#N or an issue URL (default: the one the
                 PR's ledger entries name, else the `PLAN:` line of the PR
                 body)
  --ask ASK      The ask whose Done-when the plan must cover (as `plan check
                 --ask`)
  --head HEAD    The PR head sha (default: read from GitHub)
  --json
  --limit LIMIT  With `stats`: how many merged PRs to show (default 10)
  --all          Exit by the whole board, not only the gates the repo enforces
